about: The matched performance scene (M2.12c): one fishing scene both stacks draw from these numbers alone. A ground slab, a water slab, a dock of planks, a rod with its line to a bobber, and a school of fish circling the dock on fixed orbits; no physics, no randomness, no assets, no HUD. rust/bench.rs (genex) and raylib/bench.cpp (raylib-cpp v1 baseline) both echo this object in their record, so the performance row can check the pair is matched.
